## Writing Function 1 - How Many Different Taxa are Recorded at Each Site 
```{r}
TaxonRichness <- function(data) {

  result <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(site_name)) |>
    group_by(site_name) |>
    summarise(
      richness = n_distinct(analysis_taxon, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  return(result)
}
```


## Test Function 1
```{r}
SiteRichness <- TaxonRichness(opihi_master)

View(SiteRichness)
```

## Writing Function 2 - Taxon Richness for Each Site During Each Year 

```{r}
TaxonRichness <- function(data) {

  result <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(site_name), !is.na(year)) |>
    group_by(site_name, year) |>
    summarise(
      richness = n_distinct(analysis_taxon, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(site_name, year)

  return(result)
}
```

## Test Function 2
```{r}
SiteRichnessYear <- TaxonRichness(opihi_master)

View(SiteRichnessYear)
```

## Writing Function 3 - Specific Taxon at A Certain Site and Year 
```{r}
FindTaxon <- function(data, taxon, site, sampling_year = NULL) {

  result <- data |>
    filter(
      taxon_clean == taxon,
      site_name == site
    )

  if (!is.null(sampling_year)) {
    result <- result |>
      filter(year == sampling_year)
  }

  return(result)
}
```

## Test Function 3 
```{r}
FindTaxon(opihi_master, "Sargassum spp.", "Kahana Bay")

FindTaxon(opihi_master, "Sargassum spp.", "Leahi")

```

## Writing Function 4 - How Many Sites Recorded a Particular Taxon Each Year 

```{r}
TaxonByYear <- function(data, taxon) {

  result <- data |>
    filter(taxon_clean == taxon) |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarise(
      number_sites = n_distinct(site_name, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(year)

  return(result)
}
```

## Test - Function 4

```{r}
TaxonByYear(opihi_master, "Dictyosphaeria versluysii")

TaxonByYear(opihi_master, "Diadema paucispinum")
```
